sport.title: Aryna Sabalenka told she should be fined as she is criticised for ‘disgusting behaviour’ at the WTA Finals
paras: Aryna Sabalenka continues to receive backlash for her actions during her match against Elina Svitolina at the WTA Finals. Sabalenka was beaten by Svitolina in her final round-robin match in Indian Wells, confirming her exit from the WTA Finals and bringing an end to what has been a relatively disappointing season for the Belarusian.

Perhaps the biggest talking point from this match came in the third set, when Sabalenka was overheard speaking in Russian, as she appeared to be making anti-Ukrainian comments. Sabalenka has since released a statement to clarify that these comments were not about Svitolina and instead at some Ukrainian supporters in the stands, who she claimed were ‘aggressively’ cheering her mistakes.
